title: Fix PRs
subtitleOpen: {count, plural, one {# fix PR} other {# fix PRs}} waiting for review
subtitleNone: No fix PRs waiting for review
bridge: Code fixes drafted by AI · on GitHub they open as pull requests (PRs)
empty: No runs yet. Click “Create fix PR” on a feedback group in the dashboard and runs collect here.

merge.demo: Checked whether fixes shipped. Nothing new shipped (this is a practice screen, so the examples stay as they are).
merge.slow: Checking PRs on GitHub one by one. This can take up to 2 minutes.
merge.failed: {count, plural, one {# PR} other {# PRs}} failed to check · open the run details to find the cause and retry
merge.delivered: Sent {count, plural, one {# notification} other {# notifications}} to the people who reported
merge.already: Notifications already went out for fixes that shipped · check deployment and resolution in the details
merge.deferred: {count, plural, one {# notification} other {# notifications}} will be sent next time
merge.skipped: {count, plural, one {# run} other {# runs}} will be checked next time

errors.shape: The response wasn't in the expected shape

pr.publishing: Checking the creation result · duplicate creation on hold

userConfirm.unresolved: Some replies say it's still broken

detail.followUpHint: {error} · you can check again with “Check for shipped fixes”
detail.noChecks: No record of checks that ran.
detail.closedLine: {when} · Closed without shipping. No notification goes out
detail.shippedNotified: · {count, plural, one {# notification went} other {# notifications went}} out at {time}

notify.title: Notifications
notify.sub: Tells people the fix shipped. Deployment and resolution are checked separately
notify.empty: No notifications sent yet. Click “Check for shipped fixes” to detect the ship and send them.
notify.waiting: Waiting · delivered when they next message
notify.emailUnknown: · Email delivery needs checking · resend on hold until the provider confirms
notify.emailSkipped: · Email not sent · joined a repeat report
notify.channelFailed: {count, plural, one {# Channel Talk notification} other {# Channel Talk notifications}} not sent
notify.kakaoPending: {count, plural, one {# KakaoTalk notification goes} other {# KakaoTalk notifications go}} out when that person next messages. It can't be pushed from here.
notify.kakaoNote: On KakaoTalk, the notice is added in front of the reply after the person next messages. For “Still broken”, continue in the Inbox tab.

closeReason.hintEmpty: Pick a reason and you'll see which mistakes repeat
closeReason.notePlaceholder: Note (optional) — one line on what was wrong
closeReason.noteAria: Note on why the fix wasn't shipped

log.title: Run log
log.note: Check the validation record above for the actual results. With no record, validation is unconfirmed. Shipping, deployment and user confirmation are separate steps.
log.idle: Choose a run and its log flows here
log.disconnected: The live connection dropped. Checking the saved run state again.

retry.remaining: {count} left. Press again, or they go out when the customer next messages
retry.cantNow: No notifications can be sent right now
retry.exhausted: {count} failed several times and won't be sent again. Check the Channel Talk connection and that the conversation is still open
retry.skippedNonChannel: {count} are on another channel and go out when the customer next messages

diff.patchTruncated: The change is long, so only the beginning is shown. See the full diff on GitHub.
diff.noPreview: This file can't be previewed (it's binary or too large).
diff.filesTruncated: Over 100 files, so only some are shown. See all of them on GitHub.

facts.pickedUnconfirmed: <m>Picked element </m><l>{label}</l><m> · couldn't confirm in the repository source</m>
facts.previewAfterShip: Whether a preview exists after shipping depends on the deployment service
facts.previewLogin: You need to be logged in to Vercel to open it
facts.previewSoon: A link appears when the deployment finishes
facts.previewNoRepo: This repository has no preview deployment
facts.buildUnavailable: Couldn't ask for the build status — the token lacks Checks / Commit statuses permission, or GitHub refused. You'll ship without a check
facts.noVercelWaiting: Vercel isn't connected to this repository
facts.noVercel: Vercel isn't connected to this repository. Shipping isn't blocked

waiting.title: Waiting for automatic checks
waiting.tail: It becomes ready for review once they pass
waiting.tailNoChecks: With no checks to wait for, it becomes ready for review 10 minutes after the PR opens

failed.title: Automatic checks failed, so it stays a draft

promoted.title: Passed the automatic checks and was marked ready for review
promoted.titleNoChecks: There were no automatic checks to wait for, so it was marked ready for review 10 minutes after the PR opened

unsupported.title: This repository doesn't support draft PRs, so it was opened directly

human.title: No permission to read check results, so it wasn't changed automatically

manual.title: The owner turned this PR back into a draft

transient.title: Something went wrong, so it couldn't be changed automatically

unverified.title: Couldn't verify
unverified.wrongCause: Don't ship, citing “Fix with the wrong cause”

how.reporter: Can't be checked in code · only the reporter knows
how.human: A person has to check it in the preview

unverified.footer: Check it in the preview before you ship.

explanation.title: What this fix does
explanation.sourcePrBody: No saved explanation, so this was extracted from the PR body
explanation.sourceAi: The explanation the AI wrote while fixing the code
explanation.none: This fix has no explanation. See “Changed code” below and the PR body on GitHub.

review.devNote: For developers · click a file to expand
review.aiNote: The AI's code judgment is advisory. Check the validation record above for the actual results.
review.buildFailedHelp: Check the <log>build log</log>. If it can't be fixed, choose “{reason}” under “{action}”. The button unlocks once the build passes again.
review.pollStopped: It's been over 30 minutes, so automatic checking stopped. <retry>Check again</retry>
review.shipSummary: Ship PR #{number} to the service and send a notification to {people, plural, one {# reporter} other {# reporters}}. Deployment success and problem resolution are checked separately. Check email delivery results in the follow-up records. The GitHub ship record is attributed to the connected account.

close.title: Don't ship
close.desc: Pick one reason and you'll see which mistakes the AI repeats. Nobody who left feedback is notified, and PR #{number} on GitHub is closed.
close.noteAria: Note on why it isn't shipped
close.groupNote: This feedback group returns to “open”. You can request a new fix later.

notice.shipped: Shipped · {count, plural, one {# notification} other {# notifications}} ready
notice.mergeMethod: Shipped with the default method because of the repository settings

mergeReason.transient: Something went wrong, so shipping was paused. Please try again in a moment
mergeReason.checks_unavailable: Shipping was paused because there's no permission to read check results. Check the check-read permission on GitHub and try again

mergeBlock.closed: This fix was already closed on GitHub
mergeBlock.build_failed: Shipping is blocked because the build failed. Shipping in this state may break the service
mergeBlock.build_pending: The build is still running. You can ship once it finishes
mergeBlock.conflict: The original code changed in the meantime and conflicts with this fix. Resolve the conflict on GitHub before shipping
mergeBlock.draft_waiting: This draft is waiting for automatic checks. You can ship once it becomes ready for review
mergeBlock.manual_draft: The owner turned this PR back into a draft. Mark it ready for review on GitHub to ship

verdict.fix_holds: AI opinion · the reasoning for the fix looks sound
verdict.fix_does_not_hold: AI opinion · the reasoning for the fix has problems

hallucinated_path.label: Invented a path or symbol that doesn't exist
hallucinated_path.hint: References a nonexistent file, function or translation key, so the build breaks or a useless file appears (PR #1·#5 type)

wrong_causality.label: Fix with the wrong cause
wrong_causality.hint: Changed a real file, but it has nothing to do with the symptom or can never run (PR #6 type)

duplicate.label: Duplicate PR
duplicate.hint: A PR for the same problem already existed (PR #4 type)

superseded.label: Replaced by another PR
superseded.hint: A person fixed it directly, or another PR solved the same problem

other.label: Other
other.hint: A reason not listed above — write it in the note

stopReason.root_cause_unknown: The AI couldn't find the file that causes the problem — it reopened the file it pointed to once more but couldn't settle on where to fix
stopReason.insufficient_evidence: Not enough evidence — couldn't find code in the repository that matches the report
stopReason.no_change: The AI decided there was nothing to fix
stopReason.reproduction_already_passes: The reproduction check already passed before the fix, so there's nothing to fix
stopReason.budget_exhausted: Time or cost budget used up — a retry can pick a different candidate
stopReason.budget_unverifiable: Model settings whose cost can't be calculated — needs an admin check
stopReason.group_follow_up_hold: On hold until the follow-up check on the previous PR in this group finishes
stopReason.target_group_changed: The target group changed during the run
stopReason.execution_lease_lost: Another run took over the same job, so this one stopped
stopReason.validated_evidence_present: A run with a passing validation record isn't resumed without validation
stopReason.publication_reconciliation_binding_misma: Stopped because the publish record and the fix don't match
stopReason.validation_binding_mismatch: Stopped because the validation record and the fix don't match
stopReason.validation_profile_digest_mismatch: Validation settings changed during the run
stopReason.invalid_validation_profiles: Validation settings have an invalid format
stopReason.validation_profiles_absolute_path_requir: Validation settings paths must be absolute
stopReason.repository_mismatch: The repository changed during the run
stopReason.foreign_publication_branch: A branch with the same name already exists, so it wasn't overwritten
stopReason.foreign_publication_pr: A PR for the same branch already exists, so a new one wasn't opened
stopReason.snapshot_too_large: The repository is too large for isolated validation
stopReason.snapshot_file_too_large: A file over 1 MB blocks isolated validation
stopReason.snapshot_tree_truncated: The repository tree was cut off, so isolated validation couldn't run
stopReason.snapshot_unsupported: A file type that isolated validation doesn't support
stopReason.unsafe_snapshot_path: An unsafe path blocks isolated validation
stopReason.unsafe_snapshot_symlink_or_submodule: Symlinks or submodules block isolated validation
stopReason.durable_publication_callbacks_required: Internal error — publish record callback missing
stopReason.durable_attempt_callbacks_required: Internal error — attempt record callback missing
